first_broken_edge.finding: Runtime telemetry is now causally sufficient, but no deterministic compact verifier joins the complete two-baiter task episode, accumulated intent equivalence, selected legacy candidate, native launch receipt, and multi-tick physical progress.
first_broken_edge.effect: A live run cannot be admitted as evidence because manual log review could miss a non-exercised mechanic, one-baiter episode, transient divergence, ambiguous proposal, missing receipt, or movement that was submitted without physical progress.

next_phase.objective: Implement one fail-closed deterministic verifier over normalized status, diagnosis, trace, and native movement receipt rows and emit only a compact JSON decision summary.

pass_contract: one exact lifecycle scope contains a complete transfer-lane episode for both assigned baiters
both actor tasks are observed running and each has exactly one eligible movement proposal per observed comparison
each actor retains one stable scope, actor, episode generation, task generation, shadow key, legacy key, and immutable destination
all eligible comparisons are equivalent with zero divergence, ambiguity, shadow-only, legacy-only, key changes, or destination changes
each stable legacy candidate key joins to at least one native movement launch receipt for the same actor and lifecycle scope
native receipts prove launch or spline submission and later observations prove semantic distance improvement and arrival or success for both actors
no join is inferred only from timestamps or approximate coordinates
fail_closed_contract: missing complete episode, missing second baiter, missing actor identity, or zero eligible comparisons is not_exercised
any divergence, ambiguity, unstable key or destination, mismatched actor or scope, missing exact receipt join, or missing physical progress is fail
malformed JSON, mixed lifecycle scopes, schema ambiguity, duplicate conflicting identities, or unavailable required streams is fail
the verifier must never classify action submission alone as progress
the verifier must never start a server, mutate a database, provision a shard, or change gameplay code
test_matrix: canonical pass with two baiters and exact receipt/progress joins
transient divergence followed by equivalence remains fail
scope or actor mismatch remains fail
receipt submitted without later physical progress remains fail
retired terminal episode can pass after the shared shadow becomes inactive
malformed or mixed-schema input remains fail

promotion_gate.required_evidence: Verifier implementation and synthetic matrix pass, master tests pass, and worldserver remains buildable.
